prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.0%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Story Scroll Path Selector Reorder', 'Account Sync Status and Reset Recovery Banner', 'Story Path Instant Pick Hint', 'Adoption Certificate Mascot Celebration Banner', 'Interactive Pre-Made Pet Selector Carousel', 'Desktop Overlay Status Check Banner']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Defer Sign-In Post Pet Creation', 'Interactive Pet Selector Split Redesign', 'Interactive Waiting Screen with Notification Toggle', 'Stage-Based Preset Pet Visualizer', 'Interactive Pet Controls Tutorial', 'Existing Account Recovery Warning', 'Desktop Ready System Notification Prompt', 'Clear Onboarding Duration Copy', 'Desktop Engine Initialization Status Screen', 'Stage View Pet Selection Cards', 'Pre-Adoption Desktop Visibility Check', 'Path Explorer Decision Helper', 'Interactive Generation Tip Carousel', 'Desktop Controls Quick Start Walkthrough', 'Adoption Certificate Name Validation Callout', 'Home Intro Spotlight Walkthrough Layout', 'Adoption Preview Split Redesign', 'Sign In Deferred After Pet Selection', 'Generation Progress Stage Breakdown', 'Account Existing Pet Sync Check', 'Story Companion Intro Split Screen', 'Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Selection', 'Desktop Presence Troubleshooter Callout', 'Interactive Pet Path Choice Cards', 'Early Account Sync Verification Step', 'Desktop Quick Controls Card Screen', 'Path Explorer Fast Track Hint', 'Adopt Stage Grid Redesign with Live Pet Preview']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Account Reset and Pet Sync Warning Card
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to a split layout with explicit account sync warning cards to prevent pet resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Keep Your Desktop Companion
sign_in.body: Sign in to securely back up your pet. Using a different login method may create a blank account.

components.text: Warning: Re-signing in with a new email resets your active pet.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Quality Preview Checker Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen 'new_pet_preview_check' before adoption confirmation to allow pet appearance validation.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results, and adoption conversion is 68.5%.

candidates.title: Story Path Reorder with Compact Selection
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding path screen sequence and switch choose_path layout to story_scroll.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s and 20.9% drop-off.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Onboarding Flow
candidates.change: Transform home_intro into an interactive quick-start control flow explaining how to talk to, hide, and summon the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling or hiding the pet, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Controls
home_intro.body: Learn how to summon, interact, and manage your pet on your desktop screen.

components.text: Press Alt+P to hide or show your pet anytime.
Right-click pet for interactions and voice controls.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Diagnostic Status Banner
candidates.change: Add an explicit initialization progress status check and diagnostic checklist to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails complained about the pet failing to appear on desktop or app stalling during launch.

waiting.headline: Initializing Desktop Pet Engine
waiting.body: Setting up desktop overlay and rendering companion graphics...

candidates.title: Pet Name Certificate Grid Showcase
candidates.change: Update adoption_certificate layout to two_column with visual mascot confirmation badges.
candidates.why: Adoption has a long mean duration (1017s) and 31.5% drop-off.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your pet details and start companion initialization.

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Ready Countdown Timer
candidates.change: Display an active render timer and completion hint on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.

waiting.hint: Your pet is rendering in the background. This typically takes less than 2 minutes.

candidates.title: Existing Account Sync Recovery Guidance
candidates.change: Add clear copy and recovery hints on sign_in to help users log into existing pet accounts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited lost or reset pets due to duplicate account creation during sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Welcome Back to Your Desktop Companion
sign_in.body: Please sign in with your original credentials to restore your existing pet setup.
sign_in.hint: Need help finding your existing pet account? Use your primary email address.

candidates.title: Compact Path Selection Card Layout
candidates.change: Switch choose_path layout to compact grid with emphasis choice cards.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean of 514s and drops 20.9% of users.

components.text: Choose between Interactive Desktop Mascot or Chill Companion mode.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Quick Reference Spotlight
candidates.change: Update home_intro to spotlight layout featuring desktop control shortcuts and toggle hints.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is low (64.8%) and users struggle with post-setup desktop pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.hint: Double-click your desktop pet anytime to open fast control settings.

components.text: Tip: Right-click pet to hide or snooze
